edit.description: a `not-shipped` record whose own `touchedPaths` name a continuing note is no standing refusal
the classification over both kinds of not-shipped record

summary: `not-shipped` is classified as plan's by mode alone, so a continuation wakes the drain on nothing plan can reconcile
acceptance: a continuation leaves build in the wake set and the drain's window closed, while a park still opens it
tests: a not-shipped record whose commit wrote a continuing note is not a standing refusal
pins: a not-shipped record whose commit wrote a park note is a standing refusal
notes: Which of the two a not-shipped record is is the chain's vocabulary, read from where it told its agent to say so (`spec/pending.md`, the not-shipped predicate). The record already carries the evidence: `NotShippedAttempt.touchedPaths` is the same list the `shipped` predicate was handed. The per-entry refusal already declines to hold a not-shipped entry, so nothing there changes.
